samples.prompt: Ms Brown, an event organiser, has invited you to a responsible wildlife travel talk. Accept the invitation, confirm the arrangements and ask about preparation while offering help.
requirementsVi: Nhận lời rõ ràng, không chỉ cảm ơn lời mời.
Xác nhận thông tin người mời đã đưa.
Nêu sự quan tâm và hỏi chuẩn bị bằng câu gián tiếp.
samples.summaryVi: Tham quan thiên nhiên cần quan sát có khoảng cách; nên hỏi cách chăm sóc động vật thay vì chỉ xem quảng cáo.

paragraphs.label: Mở thư và nhận lời
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

Thank you for your invitation to a responsible wildlife travel talk. I am pleased to accept and would welcome the opportunity to take part. I appreciate the time you have spent making the arrangements.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nhận lời rõ ràng, không chỉ cảm ơn lời mời.

parts.labelVi: danh xưng và họ người nhận

parts.text:

a responsible wildlife travel talk
. I am pleased to accept and would welcome the opportunity to take part. I appreciate the time you have spent making the arrangements.

paragraphs.template:
Dear [danh xưng và họ người nhận],

Thank you for your invitation to [sự kiện / hoạt động]. I am pleased to accept and would welcome the opportunity to take part. I appreciate the time you have spent making the arrangements.

paragraphs.label: Xác nhận sắp xếp
paragraphs.text: I understand that the event will take place at the local library on Saturday at two in the afternoon. I will plan my journey accordingly. Please let me know if there are any changes to the time or location.
paragraphs.noteVi: Xác nhận thông tin người mời đã đưa.

parts.text: I understand that the event will take place at
the local library
on

. I will plan my journey accordingly. Please let me know if there are any changes to the time or location.

paragraphs.template: I understand that the event will take place at [địa điểm] on [ngày và giờ]. I will plan my journey accordingly. Please let me know if there are any changes to the time or location.

paragraphs.label: Chuẩn bị và hỗ trợ
paragraphs.text: I am particularly interested in the opportunity to compare nature tours and discuss respectful observation. One reason is that visitors can enjoy nature without treating animals as objects for entertainment. I can bring a notebook for travel questions, but I would be grateful if you could confirm whether anything else is required. I would also be happy to assist with the preparations if needed.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu sự quan tâm và hỏi chuẩn bị bằng câu gián tiếp.

paragraphs.label: Kết thư
paragraphs.text:
Thank you for your time and consideration. Please let me know if you require any further information. I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,
Minh Nguyen
